# Artikit

> Artikit is a set of standalone HTML sample pages (landing pages, dashboards, data pages, canvas pages, blog templates and a terminal design system) to use as starting points for new UI. Each page is one self-contained file with its CSS and JavaScript inline and sample data only. There is no build step and nothing to install.

How to use this file:

- Paths are relative to the directory this file is served from. The same paths work in the repository root.
- Every page is in `pages/`. File names start with the kind of page: `landing-page-`, `dashboard-`, `data-`, `canvas-`, `blog-` or `terminal-`.
- To reuse a page, fetch its HTML file and adapt it. Colours, fonts and radii are CSS custom properties declared in `:root` near the top of the page's `<style>` block.
- Most pages load web fonts from Google Fonts and fall back to system fonts without them. The Gimorra and Vigolium pages also load a logo from `assets/`, which they reference as `../assets/`.
- Each page has a 720×450 preview image at `thumbs/<file-name>.png`.
- `index.html` is the visual chooser. It builds its catalogue with JavaScript, so read this file for the list instead of scraping it. `index.html#list` opens it as a table, and `index.html#blog` (or any other kind) opens it filtered to that kind.
- All names, numbers and install commands in the pages are invented sample content, except in the blog templates, whose text describes the templates themselves and whose numbers were measured (the Workbench post explains the text charts page and its figures plot that page's sample data). Gimorra and Vigolium are the author's own products.

## Landing pages

- [Gimorra · Copperplate](pages/landing-page-gimorra-copperplate.html): Copperplate and porcelain marketing page: one 920px column, flat figure plates on dot grounds that light under the pointer, a motion switch that holds the whole page still, an install line and a terminal replay you can pause. The replay's content is plain data in the last script (`PHASES`, `KIDS`, `FINDS`, `SAY`), and each figure is one inline `<svg class="plate">`. Details: sans + mono, dark + light, animated SVG. Size: about 130 KB. Preview: thumbs/landing-page-gimorra-copperplate.png
- [Gimorra · Verdicts](pages/landing-page-gimorra-verdicts.html): White product page framed by hairline rails: paper-textured hero with a live verdict flow, a draggable threshold, benchmarks, quickstart tabs and a human or machine view. Details: Instrument Sans + DM Mono, light only, animated widgets. Size: about 80 KB. Preview: thumbs/landing-page-gimorra-verdicts.png
- [Gimorra · Stage](pages/landing-page-gimorra-stage.html): Near-black product page built around a playable run: a centred hero, a target switch, a staged demo with a five-step scrubber and a stop key, illustration cards, a command grid and install blocks. Details: system sans + mono, dark only, scripted demo. Size: about 60 KB. Preview: thumbs/landing-page-gimorra-stage.png
- [Coding agents](pages/landing-page-coding-agents.html): Dark landing page over a landscape painting redrawn live in ASCII glyphs: a centred prompt box with an autonomy switch, a permission matrix, a scripted session replay and an install block. Details: Geist + Geist Mono, dark only, canvas ASCII + replay. Size: about 50 KB. Preview: thumbs/landing-page-coding-agents.png

## Dashboards

- [Gimorra · Console](pages/dashboard-gimorra-console.html): All-monospace security console modelled on the real Gimorra dashboard: a flush stat grid with severity, verdict and class charts, engagements with a nine-tab run view (report, findings, jobs, knowledge base, attack surface, coverage, scope, credentials, approvals), a findings table with a proof rail and triage, targets, a new-scan form that writes its own command, and settings. Every figure is derived from the sample arrays near the top of the script (`ENG`, `RAW`, `JT`, `APPR`). Details: JetBrains Mono, dark + light, hash routes + live triage. Size: about 95 KB. Preview: thumbs/dashboard-gimorra-console.png
- [Gimorra · Console · Copperplate](pages/dashboard-gimorra-console-copperplate.html): The Gimorra · Console sample redrawn in the Copperplate theme: the same data and routes, with stat tiles, dashboard charts drawn as flat plates on dot grounds that light under the pointer (hover and arrow-key readouts, a table view per card), engagements with a nine-tab run view, a findings table with a proof rail and triage, targets, a new-scan form that writes its own command, settings, a GitHub link in the nav and the tweak dock (mode, theme, surface, font, size, corners, density, gutter, accent; adapter in `tweaks/adapters/`). The sample arrays (`ENG`, `RAW`, `JT`, `APPR`) are the console's, and each chart is one `card(id, options, draw)` definition placed with `<article data-card="id">`; tokens and `pl-*` plate paint match the Copperplate landing and data pages. Details: sans + mono, dark + light, SVG plates + hash routes, tweak dock. Size: about 140 KB. Preview: thumbs/dashboard-gimorra-console-copperplate.png
- [Vigolium · Workbench](pages/dashboard-vigolium-workbench.html): Terminal-style workbench: text-only header, pipe-separated nav, zero-radius panels and 50/50 master-detail views. Details: monospace, dark + light, ASCII charts. Size: about 90 KB. Preview: thumbs/dashboard-vigolium-workbench.png
- [Vigolium · Triage](pages/dashboard-vigolium-triage.html): Full-screen Scan & Triage Performance dashboard: stacked finding volume, open findings by severity, median triage time, a fix-time scatter and an SLA strip plot, with a project filter. Details: Inter, dark only, SVG charts + tooltips. Size: about 40 KB. Preview: thumbs/dashboard-vigolium-triage.png
- [Delivery analytics](pages/dashboard-delivery-analytics.html): Charcoal delivery-analytics dashboard: range and project filters, KPI tiles with sparklines, created-vs-completed lines, stacked columns by project, a cycle-time histogram and hatched meters. Details: Inter, dark only, filters + chart tooltips. Size: about 50 KB. Preview: thumbs/dashboard-delivery-analytics.png

## Data pages

Every data page carries a tweak dock (mode, theme, surface, font, size, corners, density, gutter, accent) and one records table with a search box, a row of switches, choosers, sortable columns and pages. The table is the same `recordsTable(root, options)` function in each page; its look is that page's own `.rt-*` CSS and its rows are sample data from the page's script. Brand marks are placeholder SVGs.

- [Observability](pages/data-observability.html): Dark observability sample with traces, logs, infrastructure and incident views and a validated series palette. The Infrastructure view lists all 48 hosts in a table with search, status, region and role filters. Details: Inter + Geist Mono, dark first, SVG charts, tweak dock. Size: about 150 KB. Preview: thumbs/data-observability.png
- [Model Data](pages/data-model-usage.html): Light-first data page with stat tiles, tables, range switches, categorical series and a catalog table of forty models with search, trend, lab and pricing filters. Flips to dark. Details: Geist, light + dark, tables, tweak dock. Size: about 160 KB. Preview: thumbs/data-model-usage.png
- [Prompt analytics](pages/data-prompt-analytics.html): Full-screen prompt analytics on a warm cream surface: prompt cards with line and bar charts, request geography, and latency, token and quantile meters, with a range switch, a table view and a request log with search, status, prompt and country filters. Details: Figtree, light first, SVG charts + tooltips, tweak dock. Size: about 120 KB. Preview: thumbs/data-prompt-analytics.png
- [Evals](pages/data-evals.html): Full-screen eval dashboard on oat with cream figure cards: hatched and solid paired columns, running-mean lines with leader labels, reference lines and error bars, all scoped by a suite switch, and a run log with search, condition, model and status filters. Details: Hanken Grotesk, light + dark, SVG charts + tooltips, tweak dock. Size: about 105 KB. Preview: thumbs/data-evals.png
- [Analysis workbench](pages/data-analysis-workbench.html): Dense light analysis workbench: contents tree, a canvas of filter, table, time-series, bar and heat-grid cards, a card inspector with search settings, a dependency graph view, and an object table of the filtered batches with search, year, site and roaster filters. Details: Inter + Geist Mono, light first, linked cards + graph view, tweak dock. Size: about 145 KB. Preview: thumbs/data-analysis-workbench.png
- [Vigolium · Charts](pages/data-vigolium-charts.html): Chart catalogue in the vigolium.com theme: warm black with a hint of gradient, square cards and twenty-five chart forms (stat tiles, line, step, area, stacked column, stacked area, grouped column, ranked bar, diverging bar, dumbbell, bullet, histogram, box plot, scatter, heatmap, donut, treemap, waterfall, segmented bar, gauge, funnel, Sankey, radar, Gantt and a sparkline table), all drawn from one seeded dataset (`DATA`) and scoped by a 7, 30 or 90 day range switch, with hover and keyboard readouts and a table view per card, and a records table of every finding with search, severity, class, project and status filters. One `card(id, options, draw)` call per chart. Details: Space Grotesk + Geist Mono, dark first, SVG charts + tooltips, tweak dock. Size: about 135 KB. Preview: thumbs/data-vigolium-charts.png
- [Vigolium · Text charts](pages/data-vigolium-text-charts.html): The same dataset in the Workbench theme, with every chart drawn in characters: block bars, eighth-block columns, box-drawing lines, shade heat grids, a tree, box plots, a waterfall, a funnel and a Gantt, twenty-two panels in all, each with a readout line and a table view, and a records table of every finding with a filter line, switches and choosers. One `panel(id, options, draw)` call per chart; `draw` is given the panel width in characters. Details: monospace, dark + light, text-mode charts, tweak dock. Size: about 115 KB. Preview: thumbs/data-vigolium-text-charts.png
- [Copperplate · Runs](pages/data-copperplate-runs.html): Run telemetry in the Copperplate theme: stat tiles and nine figures drawn as flat plates on dot grounds that light under the pointer, with tick rows per worker, stacked verdict columns, ranked bars, a funnel, a source flow and a heat grid, all from one seeded dataset and scoped by a range switch, with a cursor and readout on hover or arrow keys, a table view per card and a run log with search, status, target and mode filters. The companion to the Gimorra · Copperplate landing page: same tokens, same `pl-*` plate paint. One `card(id, options, draw)` call per figure; chart colours are the `--s*`, `--v-*` and `--o*` tokens in `:root`. Details: sans + mono, dark + light, SVG plates + tooltips, tweak dock. Size: about 115 KB. Preview: thumbs/data-copperplate-runs.png

## Canvas pages

Node-and-edge diagrams on a pannable canvas.

Gimorra · Architecture loads React, React Flow, htm and marked from esm.sh at run time, so it needs a network connection. Its content is plain data near the top of the module script (`sysNodes`, `runNodes`, `evidNodes`, `scenes`) and three Markdown documents embedded at the end of the file.

The other two have no dependencies: a small pan-and-zoom canvas in plain JavaScript, nodes as HTML buttons and edges as SVG paths. Their content is plain data near the top of the script: `DOC` and `SCENES` in Scan lifecycle (absolute coordinates and edge waypoints), `WF` in Workflows (loop workflows are laid out automatically from a list of steps; the swimlane gives its own coordinates).

- [Gimorra · Architecture](pages/canvas-gimorra-architecture.html): Interactive system-design page: three node-and-edge scenes on a pannable canvas, a detail rail with pickable options per component, a decisions panel that copies as Markdown, and the design documents rendered as pages. Details: React Flow from esm.sh, light + dark, pickable options + Markdown docs. Size: about 120 KB. Preview: thumbs/canvas-gimorra-architecture.png
- [Vigolium · Scan lifecycle](pages/canvas-vigolium-scan-lifecycle.html): Infrastructure diagram on a black canvas: hatched groups, mono group labels and pill-labelled edges follow one scan request, with a trace you can send through four outcomes and a second discovery scene. Details: Geist + Geist Mono, dark + light, pan and zoom + request trace. Size: about 60 KB. Preview: thumbs/canvas-vigolium-scan-lifecycle.png
- [Gimorra · Workflows](pages/canvas-gimorra-workflows.html): Agent workflows drawn as loop and swimlane diagrams: mono uppercase steps inside a dashed loop frame, a fan-out of specialists, and a run that ticks through each step into an activity feed. Details: Inter + JetBrains Mono, dark + light, runnable workflows. Size: about 50 KB. Preview: thumbs/canvas-gimorra-workflows.png

## Blog templates

Article pages for writing documents: one text column, a header that holds a wordmark and a scheme switch, and a one-line footer. To write a document, replace what is inside `<article class="post">`. An HTML comment above each page's `<style>` lists its blocks and their class names. All six share one stored colour scheme (`localStorage` key `artikit-blog-theme`) and follow the system setting until it is set.

- [Release post](pages/blog-release.html): White article template for a release note: a flush-left title, a 32px lede, one download box, a rail with the date, the reading time and the contents, markup beside what it draws, code with a file name and a wide table. Details: Geist + Geist Mono, light + dark, contents rail. Size: about 28 KB. Preview: thumbs/blog-release.png
- [Research note](pages/blog-research-note.html): Cream article template for a research write-up: a centred sans title, a picture on a colour plate, a meta rail, serif prose, footnotes, a numbered table and two numbered figures of four plots, drawn in cream panels on tan frames (paired hatched and solid columns with whiskers, a three-series line plot, columns and a histogram), with hover readouts and data tables. Its sample text counts the line length of its own page. Details: Albert Sans + Source Serif 4 + DM Mono, light + dark, charts + footnotes. Size: about 69 KB. Preview: thumbs/blog-research-note.png
- [Terminal playbook](pages/blog-terminal-playbook.html): Cream article template in a terminal register: bracketed key links that work as shortcuts, a pixel tile over the title, a tree of sections with a block-character progress bar, mono capitals for every heading and label, and square hairline boxes for text-mode figures, tables and code. Its sample text is a guide to choosing between the five blog templates. Details: Figtree + Spline Sans Mono, light + dark, tree rail + key shortcuts (H, B and T, with a switch in the footer that turns them off). Size: about 37 KB. Preview: thumbs/blog-terminal-playbook.png
- [Workbench post](pages/blog-workbench-post.html): All-monospace article template in the Workbench theme: a bracketed header, a pipe-separated contents row that marks the section on screen, a line of facts counted from the article, square panels for code and tables, and five figures drawn in block, shade and box-drawing characters by a small script that reads `data-` attributes (`bars`, `columns`, `line`, `heat`, `stack`). Its sample text explains how the text charts page is drawn, and its figures use that page's 30-day sample numbers. Details: monospace, dark + light, text-mode figures. Size: about 36 KB. Preview: thumbs/blog-workbench-post.png

## Terminal design system

These two are bundled apps with embedded assets. Open them in a browser instead of reading the source.

- [Terminal Design System](pages/terminal-design-system.html): Bundled design system in a warm terminal register, with a live control bar for theme, accent, font and density. Details: bundled app, warm dark, live controls. Size: 2.3 MB. Preview: thumbs/terminal-design-system.png
- [Terminal Design System · Field Notes](pages/terminal-design-system-fieldnotes.html): The same design system as a light-first kraft-paper notebook: dot-grid backdrop, ink-strip panel headers, sharp corners. Details: IBM Plex Mono, light first, compact. Size: 2.3 MB. Preview: thumbs/terminal-design-system-fieldnotes.png
